tei:div.tei:p: "$ (249)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i rjes gnang byin rlabs kyi 'byung gnas

bzhugs so// (250)༄༅// srid gsum nyon mongs bud shing kun 'joms pa// rang byung ye shes me dpung cher 'bar ba'i// dbus na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin// gtum po khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// de yi rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa ni// bla ma'i zhal nas ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul// ma nor bdag gis yi ger bkod pa la// bla ma mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum po'i rjes gnang la don gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po sngon 'gro la gnyis te/ bkod pa bshams pa/ mngon rtogs bsgoms nas bdag 'jug blangs pa'o// dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal sngon po pad 'dab bcu pa 'dab ma rnams sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus su/ 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu pa'i lte ba dang rtsibs rnams la sngon po bcu bri/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa'i las bum kyang bshams/ gnyis pa la don bdun te/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ gnyis pa yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas/ gsum pa yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas tshogs bsags pa/ bzhi pa tshad med pa bzhi sgoms pa rnams spyi dang 'dra'o// lnga pa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing ka'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i rwa ba dang 'dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar tu 'bar bar sgom pa ni srung 'khor ro// drug pa bskyed rim la gnyis te/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed do// dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du// hūm̐ yig mthing kha bcu (251)gcig las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/

gdon bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ bstan pa la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje gtum po sku mdog mthing kha dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ brang dang gsus khyim che ba/ yan lag dang nying lag rag pa/ phyag g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkhar 'phyar zhing sdigs mdzub kyi rtse nas khyung gi pho nya 'gyed pa/ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas dngul dkar gyi dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la me 'bar ba/ zhal gdangs pa/ rno zhing dkar ba'i mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ ljags rkan la 'dril ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba la bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing lhag ma mthur du 'phyang ba/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong ser pos dbu la brgyan pa/ dga' bo dang nye dga' ba dmar pos snyan cha byas pa/ pad+ma dang chu lha dkar pos phyag gdub dang zhabs gdub byas pa/ 'dab bzang dang legs ldan nag pos sku rags dang se ral khas brgyan pa/ dar sngon po stod g.yogs can/ 'od 'phro ba'i rin po che sna lngas brgyan pa/ dar gyi cod pan dang*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ khro bo bcu po yang rang lta bu'i cha lugs kyi zhal nang du gzigs par bsgom la/ de dag rnams (252)kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ mthing kha las 'od 'phros/ lcang lo can nas rang lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med du bstim/ slar rigs lnga spyan drangs la dbang bskur bas sgrib pa dag /bdud rtsi yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa la sogs rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsgom pa ni bdag bskyed do// gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin du mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du yang phyag na rdo rje la khro bo bcas bskor ba bskyed la/

ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab bo// las bum gyi nang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gzhung bzhin bskyed la/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab la sogs spyi dang mthun/ de nas rang gi snying khar pad nyi'i steng du/ rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ zhes pa'am yang na/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ phyi snod la phog lcang lo can gyi zhing khams su sbyangs/ nang bcud la phog rdo rje gtum po'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg par bsam/ sngags phreng rang gi zhal nas mdun bskyed bum bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'khor zhing thugs brgyud bskul nas sngags sgra sgrogs shing sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam la bsnyen pa bskyal lo// slar de dag pa mchod cing bstod nas/ gtor ma phul la 'dod don du gsol ba btab bo// bdun pa bdag 'jug len pa ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rim pas rang ting nge 'dzin gyis bdag 'jug blang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi rjes su gnang ba'o// dang po ni/ (253)slob ma rnams las bum gyi chus khrus byas la/ gral la 'khod de/ bgegs gtor btang zhing bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom pa'i/ de nas bla ma la rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bla ma skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa byin pa ni/ bla ma phyag na rdo rje dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa byin/ de nas sems bskyed kyi sdom pa bzung ba ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/

byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyin rnams dbyugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi jo bo nyid// bla ma phyag rdor la phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog / ces lan gsum brjod/ de dag gis sngon 'gro rnams song nas/ (254)gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rjes gnang dang lnga las/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai/ ston pa thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin// bdag cag 'khor bas 'jigs shing thugs rjes bzung du gsol// mun par gyur pa'i 'gro ba'i grong khyer na// 'jigs shing ya nga khyed la gsol ba 'debs// bde ba chen po mya ngan 'das pa'i grong*// zhabs kyi rdul la reg cing rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis gnang ba byin pa ni/ bdag gi thugs rje'i nyi ma yi// 'od kyi ma rig mun pa sel// khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum la// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab// ces brjod/ de nas slob ma rnams a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ phyag rdor mngon rtogs nas byung ba ltar bskyed pa/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas thams cad la phog pas/ thams cad phyag na rdo rje rnam pa/ sku chung la yan lag rag pa/ phyag mtshan rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa gsal ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ bla ma'i sku las kyang phyag na rdo rje'i sku dpag tu med pa chad nas byung bas/ slob ma'i lus la mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar sib sib thim par bsgom la/ spos kyi bdug /rol mo dkrol/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor sku bzhag pa'am yang na me tog 'thor la/ bcom ldan rigs sngags 'di la stsal lags kyis// (255)'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ de ltar sku'i rjes gnang thob pa'i phan yon la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su lus kyi gnad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug tu mthu stobs dang ldan pa phyag na rdo rje'i sku thob par 'gyur/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gong ltar btab la/ de nas dpon slob gnyis ka phyag rdor du bskyed pa'i snying khar pad nyi'i ster du hūm̐ yig gi mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba las/ sngags phreng baiḍūr+ya zhun ma'i phreng ba lta bu zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i zhal du bzhugs/ thugs khar 'khor bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tsan+dan ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sngags phreng nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du phreng ba la bzung la rjes zlos byed du gzhug go /de nas phreng ba slob ma'i mgrin par reg ste/ bcom ldan rigs sngags 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod do// slob mas kyang de'i 'don pa bsgyur la brjod du gzhug / 'di la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon gnyis las/ gnas skabs su sngags kyi nus pa che zhing*/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhas pa dang*/ mthar thug tu ngag bden pa'i tshig 'grub cing*/

sangs rgyas kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug bcu'i dbyangs dang ldan par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gong bzhin btab la/ slob mas lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du byas la/ mdun gyi (256)nam mkha' hūm̐ sngon po zhig bsam/ de nas rang gi lus 'ja' lus su yal nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ yig la thim pa la rig pa gtad cing*/ hūm̐ de nyid kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song bar bsam zhing*/ sems dmigs med kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /'di'i phan yon la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye ba dang*/ mthar thug tu sangs rgyas kyi thugs 'od gsal chos sku'i gnas lugs mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa yon tan gyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul gsol ba gong bzhin btab la/ slob ma phyag rdor du bskyed du gzhug la slob dpon gyis slob ma la lag pa g.yas su rdo rje gtad/ g.yon du dril bu gtad la/ 'di ni phyag na rdo rje'i phyag mtshan rdo rje dang dril bu ste/ khyod kyis rtag tu 'chang na/ thabs shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' dag thob par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// 'di'i phan yon la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug tu sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' dag 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// lnga pa phrin las rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dang gsol ba gong ltar ro// de nas slob ma phyag rdor du bskyed pa'i sku lus la/ klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan par bsam la sbrul rgyan byin/ sku stod la dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dkris par bsam la/ stod du dar sngon po g.yogs/ smad du stag sham dkri'o//

de nas dpon (257)slob gnyis ka'i gnas lngar rigs lnga'i khyung lnga bsgom la/ bla ma'i gnas lnga'i khyung rigs lnga las khyung rigs lnga chad nas/ slob ma'i gnas lnga'i khyung lnga la thim par bsam zhing*/ khyung gi tsaka li lnga rim bzhin du slob ma'i gnas lnga la bzhag la/ ngag tu/ oṃ bud+dha ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ rat+na ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ karma ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ 'di'i phan yon la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i grub cing sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ mthar thug tu sangs rgyas kyi phrin las 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro// zhes brjod/ de nas bla ma la gtang rag gi yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ deng nas bzung ste khyed bran du// zhes sogs brjod/ gsum pa rjes ni/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod gshegs gsol la sogs/ rjes chog rnams gzhan dang mthun no// bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i rjes gnang byin rlabs kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor pa 'od dpag rdo rjes bla ma'i gsungs bzhin ye ger bkod pa rdzogs so/// /maṅga laṃ/
